instruction: Crop this image to 300x300 pixels and save it as dog_cropped.png on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires cropping the dog image to 300x300 pixels and exporting it. The evaluator checks if the saved image has the exact dimensions 300x300 pixels.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all instruction requirements (crop to 300x300, save as dog_cropped.png on Desktop)
Correct logic: Uses PIL to accurately read image dimensions and compare with expected values
Proper data flow: get_vm_file retrieves the image file, metric function extracts and verifies dimensions
Good edge case handling: Handles None paths, file open errors, and missing expected values gracefully
Correct expected values: 300x300 matches exactly what instruction requires
Appropriate postconfig: 2-second sleep allows GIMP to complete file save operation
State accessibility: Saved file on Desktop is reliably accessible via get_vm_file getter
